title: Marketing in Automotive lighting/ Marketing Executive
description:
Roles & Responsibilities: 
 Understand automotive lighting trends, OEM strategies, competitors and emerging technologies. Build relationships with OEMs & Tier-1 customers and understand what they need next. Identify new customers, projects and applications where our technologies can create value. Work with Engineering to turn automotive lighting technologies into compelling customer solutions and presentations. Strengthen our customer portfolio and connect market insights with opportunities across India and global markets. Convert market and customer information into clear insights, reports and actions for the organization. Automotive Lighting & OEM companies knowledge are an added advantage.

Key Skills: OEM Marketing,Automotive Lighting,Customer Acquisition,Lighting Systems,Multitasking,Branding,Competitor Analysis,Product Promotion
